<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M⁺ = 193.1103, matching C₁₁H₁₅NO₂), the 13C NMR (carbonyl at ~166 ppm, aromatic carbons, and aliphatic carbons including an O‑CH₃ group), and the validated SMILES that fits the formula and functional groups, the structure is N‑(2‑ethoxyethyl)benzamide.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(Nc1ccccc1)CCOCC</final_answer>
